name: Harsh Words
overview: Scripture warns against the destructive power of harsh words, showing that anger and wrath lead to evil and strife, while wise speech promotes health and peace. The Proverbs highlight how grievous words and a wrathful spirit incite conflict, whereas a gentle answer can defuse anger and a prudent person restrains their speech. Psalms exhorts believers to cease from anger and forsake wrath, emphasizing self-control as essential to righteous living. This teaching aligns with Christ's call to guard the heart and tongue, recognizing that careless words can bring judgment and division.
